entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, this VeloBand you sold me is a piece of junk. It's completely broken and I want a refund right now. I've had it.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your VeloBand. I can definitely look into this. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you kidding me? Of course, it's a technical fault! This thing is defective! The main reason I bought it is not working. It just won't sync with my phone, no matter what I do. It's useless.

I see. I definitely understand your frustration when a device won't sync correctly. For an issue like that, my next step would be to get you over to our technical support team. They can run some diagnostics and...

NO! Absolutely not. I am not spending another hour on the phone troubleshooting your broken product. I'm a VIP member, I spend thousands here. This is unacceptable. Get me your manager. I want a return label and a full refund, or I swear I will post a review about this defective junk on every single website I can find.

Okay, okay, please, there's no need for that. I apologize. You're right, as a VIP member, your experience should be seamless. Let me just pull up your order details right now. I'll bypass the transfer.

Okay, I see the order here. You received it 16 days ago. Let me just check the policy... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process a full refund for you immediately. My apologies for the confusion.
About time. That's what I expected from the start.

Of course. I've just sent a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file for you. And for the trouble this has caused, and as a thank you for your loyalty as a VIP, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account for your next purchase.
Fine. A credit is acceptable. Just make sure that refund is processed quickly. Goodbye.
It will be processed the moment the return is scanned by the carrier. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a better day.
